claim: Patchline turns adding a new ecosystem into a guided quest a contributor can finish in under one hour. A scaffolder generates the example spec, worker script, gate script, and doc stub following the established gate pattern, and a step-by-step quest walks the contributor from scaffold to a passing real-repo gate. The gate proves the scaffolder emits valid, runnable artifacts and that the quest narrative stays in sync with the required steps.
quest_steps: Scaffold the gate files with scripts/new-ecosystem.sh
Implement the detector in internal/project and emit a fact kind
Add a unit test with a positive case and a no-false-positive case
Prove the detector on a real public repository
Wire a Makefile target and a README mention
Run the gate and confirm it passes
